mcqs.question: Which of the following functions f: {1,2,3} \rightarrow {a,b,c} is bijective?
mcqs.explanation: A bijective function is both one‑one (injective) and onto (surjective). Option A maps each element of the domain to a distinct element of the codomain and covers all three codomain elements, satisfying both conditions. The other options either repeat codomain values (not one‑one) or miss codomain elements (not onto).

mcqs.question: In a library, each book is assigned a unique accession number, and each accession number is assigned to exactly one book. Which description best represents a one‑one function?

options.A: Two different books have the same accession number
options.B: One book has two different accession numbers
options.C: Each book has a distinct accession number and no two books share the same number
options.D: Some accession numbers are not used for any book

mcqs.answer: Each book has a distinct accession number and no two books share the same number
mcqs.explanation: A one‑one (injective) function requires that distinct elements of the domain map to distinct elements of the codomain. Option C fulfills this by giving each book a unique number and ensuring no duplication. Options A and B violate injectivity, while D describes an into function, not specifically one‑one.

mcqs.question: Which of the following statements about many‑one functions is incorrect?

options.A: Different elements of the domain may map to the same element of the codomain
options.B: Every element of the codomain must be the image of at most one element of the domain
options.C: A many‑one function is still a function because each domain element has exactly one image
options.D: The function f(x)=x^2 from \mathbb{R} to \mathbb{R} is many‑one

mcqs.answer: Every element of the codomain must be the image of at most one element of the domain
mcqs.explanation: In a many‑one function, several domain elements can share the same image; there is no restriction that each codomain element be hit at most once. Hence statement B is false. Statements A, C and D correctly describe many‑one behavior (e.g., x^2 maps both x and -x to the same value).

mcqs.question: If a function f: {1,2,3,4} \rightarrow {a,b,c,d,e} is defined by f(1)=a, f(2)=b, f(3)=c, f(4)=d, which of the following statements is true?
mcqs.explanation: An into function is not onto; at least one element of the codomain is not an image. Here element e of the codomain is never reached, so f is into. It is not onto, not bijective (codomain larger than domain), and it is one‑one, not many‑one.

mcqs.question: Consider the functions g: \mathbb{Z} \rightarrow \mathbb{Z} defined by g(n)=n+5 and h: \mathbb{Z} \rightarrow \mathbb{Z} defined by h(n)=2n. Which statement correctly compares their onto properties?

options.A: Both g and h are onto
options.B: g is onto but h is not onto
options.C: h is onto but g is not onto
options.D: Neither g nor h is onto

mcqs.answer: g is onto but h is not onto
mcqs.explanation: For any integer m, choosing n=m-5 gives g(n)=m, so g is onto. For h, only even integers are obtained; odd integers have no pre‑image, so h is not onto. Hence option B is correct.

mcqs.question: For the function f: \mathbb{R} \rightarrow \mathbb{R} defined by f(x)=2x+3, which of the following is true?

options.A: f is not one‑one but onto
options.B: f is one‑one but not onto
options.C: f is both one‑one and onto
options.D: f is neither one‑one nor onto

mcqs.answer: f is both one‑one and onto
mcqs.explanation: The linear function with non‑zero slope is injective because f(x1)=f(x2) implies x1=x2. It is surjective because for any y in \mathbb{R}, solving y=2x+3 gives x=(y-3)/2, which is real. Hence f is bijective, making option C correct.

mcqs.question: A function f from set A to set B is called one‑one (injective) if:

options.A: Every element of B is the image of at least one element of A
options.B: No two distinct elements of A have the same image in B
options.C: At least one element of B is not an image of any element of A
options.D: Each element of A maps to multiple elements of B

mcqs.answer: No two distinct elements of A have the same image in B
mcqs.explanation: Injectivity means distinct domain elements produce distinct images; i.e., f(a1)=f(a2) implies a1=a2. Option B states this definition. Options A and C describe surjectivity and into functions, while D contradicts the definition of a function.

mcqs.question: A many‑one function is characterized by which of the following?

options.A: Each element of the codomain is the image of exactly one element of the domain
options.B: Two or more distinct elements of the domain may have the same image in the codomain
options.C: No element of the codomain is an image of any element of the domain
options.D: Every element of the domain maps to a distinct element of the codomain

mcqs.answer: Two or more distinct elements of the domain may have the same image in the codomain
mcqs.explanation: In a many‑one (non‑injective) function, multiple domain elements can share a single codomain element. Option B captures this. Option A describes a one‑one onto function, C describes an empty mapping (not a function), and D describes a one‑one function.
